answer: Each identity must post a 700-token bond locked for 20 epochs and bind to a distinct hardware credential logged in the quartz registry. Forging N identities locks 700N tokens, of which 85 percent is slashed after a 15-epoch challenge window. Splitting identities fails because the marginal cost per fake identity stays at 700 tokens and independent jurors drawn from the nebula pool attribute shared penalties to the tundra cluster.
